development: All 13 existing real cases, including unavailable and contaminated targets; outcomes have been inspected during development.
rules: If both products select a period agreeing within1%, retain the median photometric period and source-review status.
If only one product selects a unique period, require the other product to have a compatible qualified candidate in every epoch and no unresolved nonharmonic decision.

For that case require positive deep/shallow minima, >=3 adjacent pairs with a mean difference exceeding1% of median depth and3 standard-error proxies, with >=75% same sign. Both same-family sequences must have >=3 pairs and no corresponding alternating-depth evidence, using the SAME local event windows.
All required event checks must pass every epoch. Source and novelty remain unverified; confirmed_variable and target_candidate remain false.

Short-epoch diagnostic freezes period/template from a >=3-cycle epoch; phase, amplitude and affine baseline use only the first short cycle. Later brightness is held out. The diagnostic never promotes the final period and is not coherent cycle counting across years.
limitations: All thresholds are development heuristics, not calibrated false-alarm probabilities or physical binary models.
Positive minima and no detected same-family alternation do not prove an orbital interpretation.
No labeled quiet real-star sample. No AAVSO submission.
